verdict.line: You lose if K'Sante catches you alone inside his level 6+ R (All Out) window; you win by poking from max range with Q and only transforming on your own terms.

brief.thesis: Mini Gnar's Q (Boomerang Throw, 1100 range) outranges every tool K'Sante has except his telegraphed W (Path Maker) charge-dash, so this lane defaults to a poke war you control. K'Sante's only counter is a hard all-in: Q (Ntofo Strikes) stacks that pull you in at range 2, and R (All Out) at level 6, which explains why the data shows even lane phase but K'Sante holding solo-kill edge. The 57% Gnar win rate over 270 games says the range advantage outlasts that burst window across a full lane.

theirWindow.when: After R (All Out) knocks you through a wall
theirWindow.what: You're isolated against an empowered K'Sante with increased damage and healing from All Out — Flash or E (Hop) away immediately rather than trying to fight it out.

yourWindow.when: After he whiffs W (Path Maker) or spends E (Footwork)
yourWindow.what: His only gap closer and his shield are both down, so chain Q (Boomerang Throw) and W (Hyper) auto resets for free damage with zero retaliation risk.

start.why: Sustain and stats to keep pressing Q trades through his Ntofo Strikes poke without losing the lane to attrition.

boots.why: Cuts down the autoattack and on-hit damage his Q stacks and empowered attacks rely on.

core.why: Move speed and a burst proc that fit the hop-poke-retreat pattern and hit hard once you transform.
Shreds the armor he stacks, keeping Mega Gnar trades favorable instead of just even.
Survivability answer to his R (All Out) burst and healing window at level 6+.

runes.keystoneWhy: Rewards sustained auto-attacking once you're in a fight, stacking attack speed to punish close-range trades and cycle W (Hyper) procs faster during extended skirmishes.

summoners.why: Flash is mandatory to dodge his W (Path Maker) stun and R (All Out) wall-knockback; Teleport resets waves safely given his split-push and all-in threat.

playing.title: Poke with Q, never melee
playing.detail: Stay at max range using Q (Boomerang Throw, 1100 range). Walking inside his Q (Ntofo Strikes, 450 range) lets him stack to 2 and pull you into a bad trade.

playing.title: Hold E for his W engage
playing.detail: Keep E (Hop, 475 range) ready to jump the instant he starts charging W (Path Maker). Landing it lets him knock you back and stun you.

playing.title: Respect level 6 All Out
playing.detail: From level 6 on, R (All Out) can knock you through walls and empowers his damage and healing. Don't overextend near side walls until you can answer it.

playing.title: Let rage fill through trades
playing.detail: Extended poke exchanges build your Rage passively. Time your transformation so Mega Gnar's W (Wallop) stun is ready the moment he commits W (Path Maker) or R (All Out).

playing.title: Punish his dead cooldowns
playing.detail: After he whiffs W (Path Maker) or burns E (Footwork) to disengage, both his gap close and shield are down. Chain Q and auto resets for free.

playing.title: Free transformations after 16
playing.detail: Once your R reaches its final rank the cooldown drops to 0s, so from level 16 on you can access Mega Gnar defensively every time rage fills, not just as a gated all-in button.

playing.title: Don't solo-kill, disengage instead
playing.detail: Solo-kill equity favors K'Sante because of his shockwave pull and All Out burst. Use W (Hyper) move speed to bail rather than committing to a straight fight as mini Gnar.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, and win rates are measured from live games on the current patch; the mechanical reasoning and timing calls are my own analysis.
